about: Grammar rules used when the Slideshow Viewer joins sentence builder items into a sentence (Sentence Unjumble, Translation, Hungry Translations, Gap fill). Read by sb-grammar.js. Rules run in the order listed, on each pair of neighbouring items. Set "on": false to switch a rule off. Edit with care: this must stay valid JSON.

fr.silentHExceptions_note: Words starting with h that do NOT elide or contract (h aspiré). Plurals in -s / -x match automatically.
fr.vowelExceptions_note: Words starting with a vowel letter that do NOT elide (le onze, le oui).
fr.yVowels_note: Words starting with y are treated as starting with a consonant (le yaourt, le yoga) except these.

rules.note: After a negative, un / une / des / du / de la / de l' become de, or d' before a vowel or silent h. 'il n'y a pas de' + 'une piscine' → 'il n'y a pas de' + 'piscine'; + 'une église' → 'il n'y a pas' + 'd'église'; 'je n'ai pas' + 'un chien' → 'je n'ai pas' + 'de chien'. Not after être: 'ce n'est pas' + 'un problème' stays.

à + le → au, à + les → aux, de + le → du, de + les → des. The contracted word goes with the following item: 'je vais à' + 'le cinéma' → 'je vais' + 'au cinéma'. Not before l' (à l'hôpital). Known gap: 'de' + 'le' as a pronoun ('j'ai décidé de' + 'le faire') would wrongly become 'du faire': mark such an item "gram": false.

A little word at the end of one item meets a vowel or silent h at the start of the next: je → j', que → qu', de → d' … The elided word goes with the following item: 'je pense que' + 'il est' → 'je pense' + 'qu'il est'. 'ce' only before être (c'est); 'si' only before il / ils.
a + el → al, de + el → del ('voy a' + 'el parque' → 'voy' + 'al parque'). Only lower-case el, so names such as El Salvador are left alone.
Switched off (not chosen 2026-10-17). Turn on to drop un / una / unos / unas after 'no hay': 'no hay' + 'una piscina' → 'no hay' + 'piscina'.
